Subject: Earnings Conference Call for Q2 & H1 FY27 – Audio Recording 
 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 51 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and further to our intimations 
dated October 12, 2026, titled “Intimation of Earnings Conference Call for Q2 & H1 FY27” 
and October 22, 2026, titled “Rescheduling of Earnings Conference Call for Q2 & H1 FY27”, 
we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call held today,
